articles.summary: Dear Friedreich’s Ataxia Community, We are excited to officially introduce Solid Biosciences to the FA community. Solid Biosciences was founded by individuals directly impacted by Duchenne muscular dystrophy, driven by a deeply personal mission to develop meaningful therapies for patients and families.
